scope: Targeted property tests verifying Chase Confluence, Multivalued Dependency (4NF) losslessness, Armstrong closure axioms, and Candidate Key Antichain minimality

properties_verified.details: Verified that permuting the execution order of functional dependencies preserves both the final tableau cell partition under fixpoint evaluation and the boolean implication outcome (Church-Rosser rewriting).

Verified on Fagin (1977) Employee-Skill-Language schema: check_4nf identifies non-superkey MVD violations, chase_mvd proves losslessness of binary 4NF decomposition [ES, EL] via tuple generation, and refutes non-4NF splits.
Verified across power set attribute combinations that attribute closure X^+ satisfies reflexivity, idempotence, monotonicity, augmentation, and transitivity.
Verified that candidate keys form strict antichains in the subset poset with zero proper supersets admitted and all components minimal.
